**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent) — validated redline submitted.**

- **Investigation:** The section outline contains no insurance heading, and a full-text search for insurance/coverage/certificate terms returned only an unrelated recital reference to "mortgage insurers." Section 12's miscellaneous run (Sections 13–30: assignment, notices, governing law, force majeure, etc.) ends without any coverage obligation.
- **Why it matters:** TrueLink is a hosting vendor that hosts the Web Site and transmits/processes Client data and credit repository information — a vendor processing our data with zero insurance is walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Redline:** Inserted a new Section 31 (INSURANCE) after Force Majeure and before the signature block, at the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, plus certificates on request, maintained through the term and one year after.
- **Negotiation posture:** The comment flags the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if TrueLink resists the preferred limits.
